purpose: Hardware comparison for transient shared-memory pose read failures that reset SteamVR orientation to neutral
build_method: Diagnostic APK asset replacement. Existing optical-controller regression passes. Host tests used SOCK_NONBLOCK=0 and SOCK_CLOEXEC=0 for unused Linux socket code on macOS.
Driver and new regression cross-compile for ARM64 Linux without those host substitutions; HmdDriverFactory export and dynamic dependencies verified.
APK signer matches installed build. Only the driver asset differs from the prior diagnostic APK, apart from root signature entries.
limitations: Not a full Gradle/native rebuild; APK version label inherited from donor.
Hardware effectiveness is unconfirmed before this installation; the deterministic bug may not account for all wearer-reported stutter.
